title: DreamHost Forces Password Resets Following Incident
excerpt: DreamHost has required password resets for email and FTP/SFTP users due to an ongoing security incident affecting its systems.
body_html:
Web hosting provider DreamHost has mandated password resets for both email and FTP/SFTP users.

The action comes as part of an ongoing security incident that also disrupted user connections to the company's File Manager interface.
